# Respawn Build Maker

> RPG build planner for any game. Create a Template that defines a game's
> stats, items, equipment slots, and level rules, then craft, share, and vote
> on character Builds inside it.

## About

Respawn Build Maker is a web platform for designing and sharing RPG character
builds. The core idea is a two-layer model:

- **Template** — the rulebook for a game. A template defines stats, equipment
  slots, an item/component pool, level-up rules, and constraints.
- **Build** — a character configuration made inside a template: which items
  are equipped, at what level/tier, with which components socketed, and how
  stat points are spent.

Anyone can create a template for any game, keep it updated as the game
changes, and let the community submit suggestions and vote on builds.

No account is required to explore. Templates and builds can also be kept
private, or you can sign in with Google to publish and share them publicly.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Browse templates: /templates
- Browse public builds: /builds
- Template detail: /templates/{template_id}
- Template builds list: /templates/{template_id}/builds
- Build detail: /templates/{template_id}/builds/{build_id}
- Create a template (requires account): /templates/new

## Public API

- GET /templates — list public templates
- GET /templates/{id} — template detail with rules, stats, and components
- GET /public/builds — list public builds
- GET /templates/{template_id}/builds — list builds for a template
- GET /templates/{template_id}/builds/{build_id} — build detail
- GET /stats — platform counts (templates, builds, likes)

## Stack

Frontend: Next.js (App Router). Backend: Go (Gin). Database: PostgreSQL.
Auth: Google OAuth with JWT.
